title: NAuction
description: A simple and optimized Auction plugin. Good logging and anti-duplicate system
body:
# 📦 NAuc — Advanced Auction System

**NAuc** (NexusAuction) is a high-performance auction house solution designed for modern Minecraft servers. Built with stability and ease of use in mind, it provides a seamless trading experience for your players.

---

## 🛠 Requirements
* **Java:** 17+
* **Server:** Minecraft 1.13 or higher (Paper/Spigot recommended)
* **Vault:** Required for economy integration
* **Economy Plugin:** EssentialsX or any Vault-compatible provider

---

## 💻 Commands & Permissions

| Command | Description | Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/ah` | Opens the Auction House menu | `nauc.use` |
| `/ah sell <price>` | List the item in your hand for sale | `nauc.sell` |
| `/ah search` | Search for specific items in the AH | `nauc.search` |
| `/ah expired` | Opens the list of your expired items | `nauc.expired` |
| `/ah sorts` | Opens the item sorting menu | `nauc.sorts` |
| `/ah logs` | Opens the history of sold items | `nauc.menu.logs` |
| `/ah toggle` | Toggles the AH system on or off | `nauc.admin` |
| `/ah ban` | Ban the held item from the AH | `nauc.admin` |
| `/ah unban` | Unban the held item from the AH | `nauc.admin` |
| `/ah reload` | Reloads the plugin configuration | `nauc.admin` |

---

## ✨ Features
* 🔍 **Smart Searching & Sorting:** Find exactly what you need in seconds.
* 🛠 **Admin Control:** Comprehensive tools to ban items or toggle the entire system.
* 💸 **Economy Balance:** Configurable Listing/Buying fees to keep your economy stable.
* ⏳ **Item Expiry:** Automated expiry system with a dedicated recovery menu.
* 📝 **Logging:** Detailed transaction logs for administrators.
* ⌨️ **AnvilGUI:** Immersive search input using the classic Anvil interface.

---
